body.name: posLedgerH
body.def: \(\mathcal L_H^{\mathrm{pos}}=(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{sc}},\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{fix}},\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{elim}})\) partitions \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}}\). Here \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{sc}}\) contains \(q(S=s)=\sum_v q(v,s)\) for each initialized \(s\in H\); \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{fix}}\) contains every reachable conditional margin \(m_{s,W}=\sum_{x_W}K_{s,D}\); and \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{elim}}\) contains only sign-normalized reduced denominators supplied with an exact factorization into a positive rational constant and factors already in \(\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{sc}}\cup\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{fix}}\) or nonempty sums of branch-reachable positive kernel cells.
